
  Another benefit is collaboration. Two people can attach to the same session, allowing both to observe commands and output directly. This can support
  troubleshooting, demonstrations, or working through a problem together.

  There is a learning curve: shortcuts, scrolling behavior, and nested sessions can initially feel awkward. However, you do not need to master every feature to
  benefit. Learning how to create a session, open another window, detach, and reconnect is often enough. For anyone who spends substantial time in terminals,
  those few habits can make work more resilient, orderly, and comfortable.
